T: The fire rises. So does dinner.
D: Eight years after he vanished, Batman comes back to face Bane, who has taken Gotham hostage.
P: Serve dessert when Alfred is sitting at the café in Florence.
S: Homemade soft pretzels dipped in bicarb water, topped with rock salt
Soft pretzels boiled in bicarb water, rock salt on top, baked at 220C for 12 minutes, with yellow mustard.
the masked ball where Bruce dances with Selina

Warm buckwheat blinis topped with crème fraîche, smoked salmon, lemon zest and dill, passed round on silver trays. Whisk 100g buckwheat flour, 50g plain flour, 1 tsp baking powder, 1 egg and 200ml milk into a thick batter. Drop teaspoons into a buttered pan over medium heat and cook 1 minute a side, making about 24. Cool slightly. Mix 150g crème fraîche with the zest of 1 lemon. Top each blini with a little crème fraîche, a fold of smoked salmon from 200g and a sprig of dill.
Bocconcini with basil and chilli on toothpicks with cherry tomatoes
Bocconcini pearls marinated in olive oil, basil and chilli for an hour, threaded onto toothpicks with cherry tomatoes.
M: Beef meatballs in passata sauce, in toasted long rolls under melted provolone

Parmesan beef meatballs simmered in garlicky tomato sauce, packed into toasted long rolls under melted provolone and fresh basil. Mix 500g beef mince, 1 egg, 40g breadcrumbs, 30g grated parmesan, 1 crushed garlic clove and salt, and roll into 16 meatballs. Brown in olive oil, then add 500ml passata, 2 more crushed garlic cloves and a few basil leaves, and simmer 20 minutes. Split and toast 4 long rolls. Fill each with 4 meatballs and sauce, lay over 8 slices of provolone and grill for 2 minutes until melted. Finish with fresh basil.
Gotham rib eye with creamed spinach
the rich of Gotham before Bane strikes

Rib eye seared hard and basted with garlic butter, with nutmeg creamed spinach and crispy smashed potatoes, steakhouse style. Boil 1kg baby potatoes 15 minutes, smash flat and roast in oil at 220C for 35 minutes. Season 2 x 500g rib eyes, sear 4 minutes a side in a very hot pan, then baste with 40g butter and 2 crushed garlic cloves for 1 minute. Rest 10 minutes. Wilt 500g spinach, squeeze dry and chop, then simmer with 200ml cream, a pinch of nutmeg and 30g parmesan until thick.
W: Vanilla ice cream drowned in hot espresso, amaretti on the side
A scoop of vanilla gelato in each glass with a hot shot of espresso poured over at the table.
K: Espresso shaken hard with sugar syrup and ice until frothy

Fresh espresso shaken hard with ice and a little sugar syrup until frothy, strained into chilled glasses with a twist of lemon peel. Brew 8 shots of espresso, or 320ml very strong coffee. Make a syrup by dissolving 2 tbsp caster sugar in 2 tbsp hot water. For each drink, add 2 shots of coffee and 2 tsp syrup to a shaker full of ice and shake very hard for 15 seconds until thick and foamy. Strain into a chilled martini or wine glass and twist a strip of lemon peel over the top.

s.note: Homemade soft pretzels dipped in bicarb water, topped with rock salt
s.how: Mix 500g flour, 7g yeast and 300ml warm water to a dough and rest an hour. Shape into pretzels, dip in boiling water with 2 tbsp bicarb soda and sprinkle with rock salt. Bake at 220C for 12 minutes, brush with butter and serve with yellow mustard.
